reviews.t: Upgrade kit for the NuDerma Standard and Professional
reviews.x: These wands turn any NuDerma Standard or Professional into the "Clinical" version. They contain a mix of Neon and Argon gas, and glow a weak blue color under dim light (this is normal). The blue tubes are said to give the best of both- Neon has more of a Diathermy (local heating/warming) effect, while Argon is said to have stronger effect on Acne and other skin conditions. If you broke any of your wands or enjoy your High Frequency device and want to upgrade the tubes, this is a solid choice.
Why no one had made these before, I’m not sure. But as I suffer from the occasional adult acne, I love the ability to get the benefit of both Argon and Neon in one go.

reviews.t: It gave me pimples..  not take them away!
reviews.x: I noticed a flare up of pimples come on after a about a week of using this.  I got the additional blue gas ones (neon+argon) thinking it would HELP with pimples, NOT bring them on.  Maybe that's a good thing for some folks that its essentially bringing out all the pimples just below the surface, but for me I was hoping that it would kill the bacteria and prevent them from ever coming out. This is going back.  I am going to try the orange ones and see if that gas works better for me.

claims.text: Many reviewers report clear skin benefits, including faster healing of acne and blemishes and improved skin appearance.
Reviewers value getting both Neon and Argon benefits in one attachment, and several describe it as a worthwhile addition or upgrade to their existing NuDerma set.
Some reviewers find the blue attachments glow only a weak purple/blue rather than a strong blue, and a few note the current feels weaker than other NuDerma products.
A few reviewers mention needing to moisturize or use gel because the treatment can be drying.
Reviewers praise NuDerma's customer service and responsiveness to questions or concerns.
